claims.quote: Type locality: Banjarmasin, South Kalimantan, Borneo, Indonesia

Known from the Malay Peninsula and Singapore plus Greater Sunda Islands of Sumatra, Borneo and Java, with populations from Thailand, Cambodia, Laos and Vietnam which had formerly been considered conspecific now referred to K. geminus (Ng, 2003).
